scope: Delivery-structure cleanup among existing elementary allocation-bearing programme sites; fixed live pre-pass cohort, append-only source evidence; no assessment, identity, language-allocation or population-model changes.
temporal_policy: New decisions are reviewed for 2025-26 only. Source years and undated standing descriptions retain their actual dates. No new fact is eligible for spring 2025 (2024-25) or earlier analyses.
delivery_definition: Whole-school means the campus student body receives academic DL; parallel DL language pathways may be campus-wide collectively. It does not mean every pupil is in every language track. A separate monolingual/general-education pathway supports strand delivery. Grade-limited rollout does not establish tested-grade whole-school exposure.
